evidence: Original photo looks out onto The Edinburgh Woollen Mill: white corner façade, red quoins/window frames and fascia, with a blue traffic sign and railing outside.

Independently inspected Mike Pennington’s geotagged original photograph of the Blairgowrie branch. The corner entrance, red fascia, white corner, red-trimmed windows and street furniture match the supplied café view.

Local community heritage record places that branch at 20 Wellmeadow, Blairgowrie. Local tourism listing places The Wee Coffee Shop at 1 Allan Street, Blairgowrie. The requested answer is the town/city, not the chain’s name.
